name: Decoy Font Component

title.zh: Decoy Font · 观察同一字体的层叠字形与有限

description.zh: 看原试字框的DECOY FONT与64px真实状态。 Decoy Font是Mixfont发布的一款派生TTF字体实验，以层叠字形做远近阅读实验，并提供网页试字与字体下载入口。免费及商用须遵守原字体许可的版权、命名与分发限制，抗AI识别效果未在本次验证。
description.en: Decoy Font is a Mixfont TTF experiment derived from DejaVu Sans Mono, presenting layered letterforms through a web tester and downloadable font. Free and commercial use remains subject to the original notice, naming and distribution terms. This review records visible samples, without testing AI resistance or the downloaded font package.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Decoy Font (https://www.mixfont.com/experiments/decoy-font).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看原试字框的DECOY FONT与64px真实状态。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看Decoy标题和层叠字样，再读TTF说明下实际加载的短句，只记录这段可见字符。试字框原状态是DECOY FONT、64px，不能据此宣称完整字符集或已验证抗AI效果。适合观察混合字形，本次未下载验包，抗识别只作站方主张。字体可合规免费和商用，须留版权许可、修改遵守命名限制且不得单售字体，制作源码未知。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
